dedupe_keys.name: a comprehensive database of seismic designs and fundamental period predictions for buckling restrained braced frames

description: A comprehensive database of seismic designs and fundamental period predictions for buckling-restrained braced frames is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Esmaeil Mohammadi Dehcheshmeh, Western University (uwo.ca). This project presents a database of 4,500 steel buckling-restrained braced (BRB) frames designed in accordance with ASCE 7 and AISC 360, focusing on buildings located in high and very high seismic regions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 9 top-level files (DOCX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fj7k-tt22. Keywords: database,  steel buckling-restrained braced frame,  fundamental period,  structural seismic response,  structural automation. Published 2025-09-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
